messages:
sara_sales: FYI — Emerald Health wants a performance POC next Tue. Goal they sent: sustained 75 qps for 1 hour, avg response ~8k tokens, target p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms. They also flagged HIPAA/BAA, customer-managed KMS, and an enterprise pricing ask (hosted vs dedicated). Can we run a smoke + 1hr soak and give a cost delta?

alex_runtime: Got it. Do they require a specific model family? quantized vs fp16 matters a lot for latency/cost.

sara_sales: They said "open to recommendations" but prefer 7B-class if it keeps latency acceptable. They mentioned privacy so prefer dedicated/private if price delta is small.

lucy_se: For planning — suggest we test two variants: rwd-7b-quant (fast, lower cost) and rwd-7b-fp16 (better quality). Run profile: 10m ramp, 50m steady at 75 qps, 10m cool-down, with a few 5qps spikes to check autoscale behaviour.

mike_infra: Note: Dedicated config for that QPS with 8k tokens might need 4 GPUs depending on batch settings. I'll validate exact GPU count after we pick model + sequence-length distribution. KMS: Dedicated supports CMK in customer account (AWS KMS) but requires a short infra setup (IAM+policy) — estimate 2-3 days.

ryan_ae: Pricing question from buyer: "what's the delta between hosted per-token vs reserved dedicated commit for steady usage?" Can someone put together a quick back-of-envelope?

alex_runtime: Quick back-of-envelope (very rough):
- Hosted (rwd-7b-quant): token price ~$0.03 / 1k tokens => 2.16B tokens (~75 qps * 3600 * 1hr * 8k avg) = 2,160M tokens -> ~ $64.8k for the hour.
- Dedicated (reserved): amortized infra + GPU seats + operational fee -> for a 1hr sustained run we'd estimate ~$6k-$12k effective (because commit amortizes).
These numbers are order-of-magnitude — need exact token calc and discount tiers.

lucy_se: That Hosted price looks scary for a 1hr 8k-token average — customers usually trim prompt/response lengths for POC. Suggest we propose a demo with truncated responses (e.g., 2k tokens) and show cost/playbook for full production. Also show caching/prefix reuse options.

sara_sales: Emerald said the 8k is a "peak use case" — we can run demo at 2k and then a single capped 1hr run at 8k to validate tail latency. Will that change infra needs?

mike_infra: Yes — 2k avg reduces GPU memory and throughput a lot. For the capped 1hr with 8k we'll need to ensure KV cache + batch config is tuned. I'll pre-warm nodes and enable continuous batching.

alex_runtime: Load generator snippet I'll use for the soak (sharing):
```bash
# vegeta example for synthetic chat payloads
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=75 -duration=1h | vegeta report -type=json > emerald-soak-report.json
# targets.txt contains a simple POST to our /v1/generate endpoint with a short prompt payload
```

lucy_se: Also will capture SDK traces and token breakdown per request. I'll push a sample prompt set and we can measure prefix reuse effectiveness.

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment: rwd-7b-quant -> staging cluster at 2025-12-03T14:00:00Z by alex_runtime. CI: successful.

sara_sales: Can we confirm timeline? Emerald prefers next Tue window 14:00-18:00 PT. Action items: Lucy run smoke + low-cost 2k soak; Alex run full 8k capped run; Mike prepare infra + KMS checklist; Ryan to capture pricing slide for AE.

alex_runtime: Timeline OK. I'll do the 8k run Wed morning if we can't get all infra ready Tue — prefer Wed 14:00 PT to match ops window.

mike_infra: KMS steps (short):
1) Customer shares CMK ARN and cross-account IAM role
2) We attach policy and validate decrypt permission
3) Test encrypt/decrypt in staging
Estimate 2-3 business days for complete validation.

ryan_ae: For the pricing slide I'll show three scenarios: Hosted POC (short demo), Hosted full (per-token), Dedicated (monthly commit) with approximate savings curve. Need exact token counts from Alex after test.

lucy_se: Security questionnaire note — Emerald requested their standard HITRUST/HIPAA attestation details. We have a HIPAA summary doc and SOC2 certs. I'll attach to the thread once I have them.

sara_sales: Emerald also flagged egress routing: they want no public internet egress for model weights. That's only possible with Private (VPC) deploy or on-prem. Flagging as potential blocker for Hosted.

mike_infra: Affirm — if they require zero egress, Hosted won't work. Private or Dedicated VPC is the path. That will affect timeline + price.

lucy_se: Proposed message to customer to align scope:
"We can do a low-cost demo (2k tokens avg) next Tue to validate latency and UX. If you want a full-production-like soak at 8k tokens we recommend Dedicated/Private (KMS + VPC) — this requires additional infra setup and ~2-3 days for KMS validation. We'll provide a separate cost estimate for the capped 8k run."

sara_sales: That message looks good. I'll send and cc engineering.

alex_runtime: After the soak I'll post p50/p95/p99, token cost breakdown, GPU utilization, and a short perf tuning note (batch sizes, kv cache hit rate).

deploy-bot: run-complete: emerald-soak-smoke (2k) — 2025-12-02T16:12:34Z. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/emerald-smoke-1123

lucy_se: Smoke done on staging (2k). p95 ~ 220ms, p99 ~ 480ms, avg tokens ~2.1k. Attached sample logs in the repo.

sara_sales: Great — I'll propose the two-step plan to Emerald: low-cost demo Tue + full capped soak later this week if they sign off on Dedicated/Private. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
